required_tests.evidence: A genuine third-UID DocumentsProvider returns text and valid PNG image document URIs through a signature-protected native Activity result. Android creates the reporter’s incoming read grants and forwards them to a third distinct recipient UID; no manual grant RPC is used. Actual document identity/MIME, mixed */* target MIME, both stream extras/ClipData items, read-only/nonpersistent/nonprefix flags and real denied writes are asserted. Real provider opens/closes are balanced once per read, with zero close errors and zero provider writes; original foreign URIs are preserved rather than converted to paths.

required_tests.evidence: The three native methods exercise post-presentation local URI revocation, ungrantable/provider-security exceptions, missing authority, outside-narrow-root local file, unsupported scheme, empty multi-file content and mixed MIME. Typed failures produce no recipient delivery or source deletion; successful presentation is reported once, never recipient completion. Local revocation is performed by its owning FileProvider UID; third-party URI grant lifetime belongs to the owned Activities, not an invented global revoke authority.
